title: Week 1 Basic: Accounts (Linux)
readme:
You administer this workstation. A security review found account problems. Fix them without removing people the company needs.

Authorized users: alice, bob.
Authorized administrators: you (the account you log in with).

Company policy:
  - Only authorized users may have accounts.
  - Only authorized administrators may have sudo rights.
  - Only real people's accounts may be used to log in (service accounts cannot).
  - No leftover groups that policy doesn't call for.

There are 5 problems, 20 points each. Do not delete alice or bob.
setup:
set -e
# Baseline for Week 1 (Accounts) Basic. Forces each problem into place so a hardened VM still
# starts with all of them.
pw() { printf '%s' "$(tr -dc 'A-Za-z0-9' </dev/urandom | head -c 14)Aa1!"; }
for u in alice bob mallory eve; do
    id "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -m -s /bin/bash "$u"
    echo "$u:$(pw)" | chpasswd
done
# 1-2) mallory and eve are unauthorized. 3) bob should be a normal user, not an admin.
usermod -aG sudo bob
# 4) an unauthorized group
getent group pirates >/dev/null || groupadd pirates
# 5) the www-data service account can log in
id www-data >/dev/null 2>&1 || useradd -r www-data
usermod -s /bin/bash www-data

checks.message: bob is no longer an administrator
The www-data service account cannot log in

pass.cmd: case "$(getent passwd www-data | cut -d: -f7)" in */nologin|*/false) exit 0;; *) exit 1;; esac
